name: gallery
description: A shared photo gallery. Upload in the browser and everyone with the site sees the same photos.

scripts.dev:cf: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --d1 DB --r2 PHOTOS
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name gallery
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 execute gallery-db --local --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute gallery-db --local --file=./migrations/0002_admin.sql && wrangler d1 execute gallery-db --local --file=./migrations/0003_users.sql && wrangler d1 execute gallery-db --local --file=./migrations/0004_security.sql && wrangler d1 execute gallery-db --local --file=./migrations/0005_consents.sql && wrangler d1 execute gallery-db --local --file=./migrations/0006_soft_delete.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute gallery-db --remote --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql --yes && wrangler d1 execute gallery-db --remote --file=./migrations/0002_admin.sql --yes && wrangler d1 execute gallery-db --remote --file=./migrations/0003_users.sql --yes && wrangler d1 execute gallery-db --remote --file=./migrations/0004_security.sql --yes && wrangler d1 execute gallery-db --remote --file=./migrations/0005_consents.sql --yes && wrangler d1 execute gallery-db --remote --file=./migrations/0006_soft_delete.sql --yes
